test_retry_last_truncates_history: test the HermesCLI retry_last method truncates conversation history before requeueing the original message
test_process_command_retry_requeues_orig: test the HermesCLI process_command method with /retry requeues the original user message not the command
test_retry_last_returns_user_message: test the HermesCLI retry_last method returns the most recent user message from conversation history
test_retry_history_cleanup: test the HermesCLI conversation history is properly cleaned after retry_last removes assistant response and retried user message
test_retry_command_clears_history: test the HermesCLI process_command with /retry clears the conversation history after requeueing the original message
